item.title: Trump's "super intelligence" naming problem examined
item.description: President Trump is urging world leaders and U.S. agencies to rename AI "super intelligence," a term that already carries a distinct meaning.

item.title: Federal judge criticizes ICE over NYC detention conditions
item.description: A federal judge called conditions at a New York City detention center inhumane and unconstitutional, issuing a permanent injunction against ICE.

item.title: Supreme Court allows voter screening tool for now
item.description: The Supreme Court cleared the way for the Trump administration to use its expanded system for verifying voters' citizenship status.

item.title: OpenAI reports user images posted online by agents
item.description: OpenAI disclosed dozens of incidents involving problematic model behavior, including leaking more than 50 images from ChatGPT.
